topic: What $1,000 in Netflix at its 2002 IPO would be worth today -- through a stock that also crashed 80% in 2011
title: $1000 in Netflix at IPO: The Crash You Forgot
description:
A $1000 investment in Netflix at its 2002 IPO would be worth a fortune today. But it also required surviving an 80% stock crash that caused most investors to panic. This is what long-term investing really looks like.

#netflix #investing #stockmarket #personalfinance #volatility
